---
title: "Rubric & Checklist"
---

# Rubric Breakdown (100 points)

| Category | Weight | Criteria |
|----------|--------|----------|
| **Question & Relevance** | 10 pts | Is the question causal? Clearly motivated? |
| **DAG & Identification** | 20 pts | DAG correct & justified, assumptions transparent, adjustment sets valid |
| **Methodology** | 20 pts | Appropriate causal method chosen, correctly implemented, diagnostics included |
| **Sensitivity & Robustness** | 15 pts | At least one sensitivity analysis, well-explained |
| **Results & Interpretation** | 15 pts | Estimates clearly reported, assumptions tied to conclusions, limitations addressed |
| **Writing & Presentation** | 20 pts | Paper clarity, organization, reproducibility (R code provided), presentation quality |

# Instructor Checklist

## Proposal (Week 9)
- [ ] Causal question is precise and relevant  
- [ ] Target trial framework specified  
- [ ] Preliminary DAG provided  
- [ ] Identification assumptions stated  

## Final Paper
- [ ] Title & abstract present research clearly  
- [ ] Introduction frames question causally  
- [ ] DAG correct and explained  
- [ ] Assumptions (exchangeability, positivity, consistency) explicitly justified  
- [ ] Identification strategy appropriate  
- [ ] Correct causal method implemented  
- [ ] Diagnostics shown (balance, overlap, IV strength, etc.)  
- [ ] Sensitivity analysis included  
- [ ] Results reported with CIs and interpretation  
- [ ] Discussion connects assumptions to real-world plausibility  
- [ ] Annotated R code in appendix  

## Presentation (Week 14)
- [ ] Clear articulation of causal question & assumptions  
- [ ] DAG presented visually  
- [ ] Results summarized without excessive technical detail  
- [ ] Interpretation emphasized over mechanics
